def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i]=values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
    Returns the values in the order mode, level, then other keys in first-given order.
    A repeated key takes its last value and keeps its first position."""
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["level", "x"], values=["5", "y"]) == ["fast", "5", "y"]
    ex settings(keys=["mode", "a", "a"], values=["slow", "b", "c"]) == ["slow", "3", "c"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    others: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i].copy()
        v = values[i].copy()
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v
        elif k == "level":
            level = v
        else:
            others[k] = v
    out: list[str] = [mode.copy(), level.copy()]
    for v in others.values():
        out.append(v.copy())
    return out
